role: CCP §340.5 MICRA defendant — medical malpractice (fraudulent/negligent competency evaluation)
theory_of_liability: Authored competency evaluation for criminal case 04-23-01959 that was self-contradicting, template boilerplate, and conducted while steward was under the influence. If Wiita is an MD, this is medical malpractice under CCP §340.5/MICRA. If a psychologist (Ph.D./PsyD), it falls under Bus. & Prof. Code §2960 et seq. with similar MICRA protections. The evaluation was used adversely against steward.

micra_considerations.statute_of_limitations: CCP §340.5 — 1 year from discovery, 3 years from injury
micra_considerations.prelitigation_requirement: CCP §364 — 90-day notice of intent to sue required before filing
micra_considerations.credential_verification_pending: Specialty and license type (MD vs. Ph.D./PsyD) not yet confirmed
